{{Top|leg}}
A '''signal station''' or '''signal tower''' was a tower-like structure that housed [[fireglobe]]s at its top. Using these illuminated objects, an operator could transmit visual messages from one signal station to another via a [[Language/Legends|language]] known as [[semaphore]]. The [[Signal Corps]], part of the militarized government of [[Alanciar]], a continent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], manned their civilization's signal stations as they kept watch for [[Invasion of Alanciar|invasion]] from the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], who inhabited the continent of [[Keshtah Minor|Keshtah]] to the west.
